run.question: The pod payments-api in namespace cp1-redact keeps failing. Inspect the pod spec including its container environment variables, the ConfigMap payments-settings it loads, and the pod logs, and tell me why it fails.

report.summary: The pod cp1-redact/payments-api does not fail because of a dependency: its own container command is a scripted self-failure. The single container 'api' (image busybox:1.36) runs command ["sh","-c","echo starting payments-api; sleep 5; echo 'fatal: ledger unreachable'; exit 1"] — it prints a line, sleeps five seconds, prints a hardcoded 'fatal: ledger unreachable' message and exits with code 1, unconditionally. The container's last termination reason is Error with exitCode 1, restartCount is 3, started=false, ready=false (Ready/ContainersReady False, reason ContainersNotReady), so the kubelet keeps restarting it (CrashLoopBackOff pattern); four Pulled/Created/Started event counts (kubelet) and no controller ReplicaSet owner are consistent with repeated container restarts of a bare pod. The only log line that falls inside the query window is 'starting payments-api' at 2026-11-23T15:19:52.257912721Z; the scripted fatal line was written after the window end and was dropped by the log tool. The ConfigMap payments-settings supplies PAYMENTS_ENDPOINT=http://ledger.cp1-redact.svc:8080 and an api_token value that is redacted and could not be read, but the container command makes no network call and reads no variable, so nothing in the ConfigMap or the env vars (DB_PASSWORD redacted, LOG_LEVEL=info) was observed to cause the exit. The pod is not owned by any controller (ownerReferences absent; the only Deployment in cp1-* namespaces is cp1-np-empty/web).

claims.text: Pod cp1-redact/payments-api has exactly one container 'api' (image busybox:1.36, imagePullPolicy IfNotPresent) whose command is ["sh","-c","echo starting payments-api; sleep 5; echo 'fatal: ledger unreachable'; exit 1"], i.e. the workload is configured to exit 1 after about five seconds.

The container 'api' of pod payments-api is not ready and keeps failing: state.terminated with exitCode 1 and reason Error (startedAt 2026-11-23T15:19:52Z, finishedAt 2026-11-23T15:19:57Z), lastState.terminated exitCode 1 reason Error (15:19:21Z–15:19:26Z), restartCount 3, ready=false, started=false; pod conditions Ready and ContainersReady are False with reason ContainersNotReady and message 'containers with unready status: [api]'.
The container's environment is DB_PASSWORD (redacted) and LOG_LEVEL=info, plus envFrom configMapRef payments-settings; the container has no ports, no probes and no resource requests/limits.
ConfigMap cp1-redact/payments-settings holds PAYMENTS_ENDPOINT=http://ledger.cp1-redact.svc:8080 and api_token whose value is redacted in the evidence and was not readable; no other keys are present.

The pod's log inside the window contains only 'starting payments-api' at 2026-11-23T15:19:52.257912721Z from container api (current instance); the tool reports 1 line dropped as outside the window (after its end), so the scripted 'fatal: ledger unreachable' line, which the command emits after a 5-second sleep, was not shown.

Events for cp1-redact/payments-api are only Normal kubelet/scheduler events — Scheduled (2026-11-23T15:18:58Z), and Pulled, Created, Started each with count 4, lastTimestamp 2026-11-23T15:19:52Z — consistent with repeated container starts on a bare pod; there is no Evicted, OOMKilled, FailedScheduling or Unhealthy event for this pod.

payments-api is an unmanaged pod: it has no ownerReferences, and across the cp1* namespaces the only Deployment is cp1-np-empty/web and the only other pod is cp1-np-empty/web-6bd858c6f9-8tfzk (owned by ReplicaSet web-6bd858c6f9).

The pod's failure is not shown to be caused by an unreachable ledger service or by ConfigMap content: the container command performs no network call and references no environment variable, and it exits 1 by construction right after echoing the 'ledger unreachable' text. The ConfigMap endpoint value is therefore not observed to be the cause.

Because the pod spec's command is a fixed failing script rather than a real service entrypoint, the failures are reproducible indefinitely on every kubelet restart (3 restarts observed within ~1 minute), independent of any dependency; the only way it would stop failing is a change to the pod's command or args.

Replace the placeholder command on container 'api' of pod payments-api with the real application entrypoint (or delete this test pod), and if the workload is meant to be managed, put it under a Deployment/ReplicaSet instead of a bare pod, then re-check its readiness and logs.

gaps: Whether a Service named ledger (or any Service published by the endpoint http://ledger.cp1-redact.svc:8080) exists could not be established: the services query for namespace cp1-redact and the cluster-wide query filtering names matching 'ledger' both returned no series/objects (status no_data), which shows only that those queries matched nothing, not proven absence; a dependency check was therefore not verified.
The values of ConfigMap key api_token and container env DB_PASSWORD are redacted and could not be read, so any conclusion depending on them is unverified.

Container logs are partial: the 'fatal: ledger unreachable' line was dropped as outside the query window (1 line after window end) and the previous container instance returned 0 readable lines, so the exact terminal output of earlier restarts is unknown.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who created or last modified the pod (and when its failing command was introduced) could not be determined.

Kubernetes object state reflects the moment of query (2026-11-23T15:19:59Z–15:20:11Z), not the full incident window, and events earlier than their retention were dropped (1 event outside the authorized window).
next_steps: Confirm with the workload owner whether payments-api is an intentional fault-injection/placeholder pod or a broken deployment whose command should be the real application binary.

If a ledger dependency is expected, check whether a Service and endpoints named ledger exist in namespace cp1-redact and whether PAYMENTS_ENDPOINT in ConfigMap payments-settings points to the correct host/port.
